cases.layout_title: 同侧折返·反冲入檐袋 / 东向镜像
cases.play_hint: 走出岩唇，身体低于檐底后向外射击，反冲折回袋内取箱。落底后可付费跳射恢复。

notes: True mirror rules.brake(1), then DX70 DY28. Upperright230→256 extend26; pocketright25→0 trim25.
Upperfloor+16; pocket468+28→480 -16. Mirror aim/axis/actor_x comparisons and all actualsolids, notgravity.
Realstart[-110,206], A dock232; B dock-24 vs old-35 shift11.
map_shape_demand.ownership: Raster actual terrain/interaction/dynamic/full-body action space, connect while excluding all port outward cells. Bounding rectangle is not a solid outer frame.
